name: forgenotes-recorder-mac
description: ForgeNotes macOS recorder for online calls and single-microphone room recordings.

scripts.verify: node --check renderer/app.js && node --check main.js && node scripts/verify-capture-profile.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:config && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never && npm run verify:mac
scripts.dist:mac:unsigned: npm run prepare:config && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false -c.mac.notarize=false

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ForgeNotes records your microphone and the meeting audio you route through BlackHole.
